# Haul Safe

> Training for hazmat carriers and drivers: RCRA/DOT combined, first responder awareness, spill prevention, spill kit use and hazardous waste manifests, with guides for drivers and waste transporters.

Haul Safe (https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA/DOT Combined, Awareness, Spill Prevention, Spill Kit Use or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [EPA RCRA/DOT Combined Hazardous Materials Compliance Training](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, RCRA + 49 CFR 172. DOT hazmat employee training combined with RCRA hazardous waste rules. Enroll: https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/epa-rcra-dot-combined-hazardous-materials-compliance-training?buy=403
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). What a driver does in the first minutes of a release. Enroll: https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing and responding to spills during loading, unloading and on the road. Enroll: https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [Spill Response Equipment - Spill Kit Selection & Use](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/spill-response-equipment-spill-kit-selection-and-use): $24.99 per seat, 1 Hour, 40 CFR 112 / 29 CFR 1910.120. Using the spill kit on your truck. Enroll: https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/spill-response-equipment-spill-kit-selection-and-use?buy=479
- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $58.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). The hazardous waste manifest from the transporter's side. Enroll: https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580

## Guides

- [Hazmat driver training: what you actually need](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazmat-driver-training-requirements): The CDL endorsement, DOT hazmat employee training and driver training are three different things.
- [A leak on the road: what the driver does](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/guides/roadside-hazmat-spill-driver): The driver is the first responder for their own load. A step-by-step plan.
- [Hauling hazardous waste: the transporter's rules](https://trucking.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hauling-hazardous-waste-transporter-rules): Waste transporters have EPA duties on top of DOT's. The essentials for drivers and carriers.
